inputs.text: John Lahart of Fianna Fáil and his colleagues are pushing the same inheritance-tax changes at once. That kind of coordination isn’t something to wave away as a fairness campaign for people without children. It looks like a deliberate effort to shape who keeps wealth and who loses it—and the people selling the exemptions clearly don’t want us asking who benefits or why this is being pushed now.

output.main_topic: Criticism of coordinated efforts to change inheritance-tax exemptions and their potential effects on wealth distribution
